mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 95 degrees with clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park, though please note an elevated air quality index of 54.
The city is planning for growth with the Plan Commission scheduled to review development projects on August 3rd, including a new subdivision addition and pickleball courts.
Today you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness, while tomorrow is packed with events including trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Louie, and Paddy Mac's.
In a noteworthy call from this past Sunday, July 26th, an officer arrested a driver for an O-W-I after catching them traveling 97 miles per hour on US Highways 18 and 151.
Cool off with our flavor of the day, Snickers Swirl, available at Culver's until they close at 10:00 p.m. tonight.
